segments.title: Cold Open & Pepito Sign-On

segments.title: Hegseth Confirmation Hearing Coverage
segments.notes: Case and Rick watch Pete Hegseth's opening remarks at 2x speed; Hegseth's mother's letter accusing him of abusing women is read on air; Kendelle walks through studio.

segments.title: Rennerton Mayoral Platform Debate

segments.title: CPU Fabrication, Whistling & Triphallia Case Study
segments.notes: Jeb and his board-trapped father demonstrate CPU manufacturing and finger-whistling; Chet and ChetAI interrupt after 'science' trigger; medical report on deceased man with three penises.

segments.title: Viral Video Review: Cheese Tax, Stretching, Wee Tennis, Batman & Video Dating
segments.notes: AI Rooney joins Case and Crum to rate viewer submissions: cheese tax song, bone-crack stretching, Australian Open wee tennis, Batman voice lineup, medical dummy exam, 1980s video dating profiles.

segments.title: Wrap-Up & Raid
segments.notes: Case announces Monday/Wednesday/Friday schedule, Patreon stream tomorrow night, inauguration day stream on Jan 20; raids Avi.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell returns from hiatus to cover Pete Hegseth's contentious Secretary of Defense confirmation hearing, featuring opening remarks at 2x speed and a damning letter from Hegseth's mother. The broadcast continues with a Munch & Crum debate on governing the zombie city of Rennerton, a How To with Jeb segment on CPU fabrication and whistling that devolves into Chet's medical revelation about a triphallic cadaver, and an Amongst the Web review of viral videos including cheese tax songs, stretching accidents, and 1980s video dating profiles.
